interpretation_note: Observed group differences are descriptive diagnostics, not proof of discrimination. Investigate data quality, sample size, feature choices, thresholds and business context before making deployment decisions.
mitigation_recommendations: Avoid unnecessary sensitive attributes in model features.
Monitor subgroup precision, recall and positive prediction rate.
Review threshold choices and error costs by group.
Document data provenance, limitations and intended use.
Re-evaluate fairness after every major data or model update.
